identification: Nintendo Game & Watch Donkey Kong Jr., model DJ-101 (wide screen, green faceplate, 1982). Photo 1 shows the original Nintendo faceplate, GAME A/GAME B/TIME/ALARM/ACL, JUMP and CONTROL cross pad, with scratched and mottled screen. Looks original. Back, battery cover and serial not shown; working state unknown.

viewing_check: Open the back: check the battery compartment for corrosion or leakage, the model code DJ-101 and serial on the rear label, and the Nintendo/Made in Japan marking (rule out a reproduction). Insert a battery if allowed and test that the LCD segments and buttons work; check for screen delamination. Note any box or stand.
